meta.attribution: Server records originate from the official MCP Registry maintained by the Model Context Protocol project.
meta.disclaimer: Compatibility verdicts are derived from published registry data and documented client behaviour. No connector was executed or audited.

connector.name: Browser Devtools MCP
connector.registryDescription: Playwright browser & Node.js MCP. ARIA refs, screenshots, ref-based interactions.
connector.summary: Hosted at {your_mcp_server_host} over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package browser-devtools-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the serkan-ozal account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PLATFORM
env.description: Platform: browser (default) or node for Node.js backend debugging.

env.name: PORT
env.description: Port for HTTP transport.

env.name: SESSION_IDLE_SECONDS
env.description: Idle session timeout (seconds).

env.name: SESSION_IDLE_CHECK_SECONDS
env.description: Interval for checking idle sessions (seconds).

env.name: SESSION_CLOSE_ON_SOCKET_CLOSE
env.description: Close session when socket closes.

env.name: CONSOLE_MESSAGES_BUFFER_SIZE
env.description: Maximum console messages to buffer.

env.name: HTTP_REQUESTS_BUFFER_SIZE
env.description: Maximum HTTP requests to buffer.

env.name: BROWSER_SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS_ENABLE
env.description: When true, include server instructions in MCP server info (browser platform). Default: true.

env.name: BROWSER_POLICY_UI_DEBUGGING_ENABLE
env.description: When true, include UI_DEBUGGING_POLICY in server policies (browser platform). Default: false.

env.name: BROWSER_HEADLESS_ENABLE
env.description: Run browser in headless mode.

env.name: BROWSER_PERSISTENT_ENABLE
env.description: Use persistent browser context (preserves cookies, localStorage, extensions).

env.name: BROWSER_CDP_ENDPOINT_URL
env.description: CDP attach: http(s) root or ws(s) URL. Resolves via /json/version, /json/list, or ws /devtools/browser (Chrome 136+). Mutually exclusive with BROWSER_PERSISTENT_ENABLE.

env.name: BROWSER_CDP_ENABLE
env.description: When true and no BROWSER_CDP_ENDPOINT_URL: probe 127.0.0.1:9222 then :9229 for CDP. Else use BROWSER_CDP_ENDPOINT_URL or default http://127.0.0.1:9222.

env.name: BROWSER_CDP_OPEN_INSPECT
env.description: On loopback CDP failure, if Chrome is running, open chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging. Default true. Set false to disable.

env.name: BROWSER_PERSISTENT_USER_DATA_DIR
env.description: Directory for persistent browser context user data.

env.name: BROWSER_USE_INSTALLED_ON_SYSTEM
env.description: Use system-installed Chrome browser instead of Playwright's bundled browser.

env.name: BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH
env.description: Custom browser executable path.

env.name: BROWSER_CHROMIUM_SANDBOX
env.description: When false, launches Chromium with --no-sandbox. Required for Docker/Lambda/CI.

env.name: BROWSER_LAUNCH_ARGS
env.description: Extra Chromium launch args (comma-separated).

env.name: BROWSER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
env.description: Comma-separated list of allowed hostnames. When set, all requests to non-matching hosts are aborted. Subdomains match automatically.

env.name: BROWSER_LOCALE
env.description: Browser locale (e.g., "en-US", "tr-TR").

env.name: OTEL_ENABLE
env.description: Enable OpenTelemetry integration.

env.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
env.description: OpenTelemetry service name.

env.name: OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION
env.description: OpenTelemetry service version.

env.name: OTEL_ASSETS_DIR
env.description: Directory containing OpenTelemetry bundle files.

env.name: OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_USER_INTERACTION_EVENTS
env.description: User interaction events to instrument (comma-separated, e.g., "click,submit").

env.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_TYPE
env.description: OpenTelemetry exporter type: "otlp/http", "console", or "none".

env.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_HTTP_URL
env.description: OpenTelemetry collector base URL (e.g., "http://localhost:4318").

env.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_HTTP_HEADERS
env.description: OpenTelemetry exporter HTTP headers (comma-separated key=value pairs).

env.name: AWS_REGION
env.description: AWS region for Bedrock usage.

env.name: AWS_PROFILE
env.description: AWS profile name for Bedrock usage.

env.name: AMAZON_BEDROCK_ENABLE
env.description: Enable Amazon Bedrock usage.

env.name: AMAZON_BEDROCK_IMAGE_EMBED_MODEL_ID
env.description: Amazon Bedrock image embedding model ID.

env.name: AMAZON_BEDROCK_TEXT_EMBED_MODEL_ID
env.description: Amazon Bedrock text embedding model ID.

env.name: AMAZON_BEDROCK_VISION_MODEL_ID
env.description: Amazon Bedrock vision model ID.

env.name: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Figma API access token for design comparison.

env.name: FIGMA_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Figma API base URL.

env.name: DAEMON_PORT
env.description: Daemon mode port (CLI).

env.name: DAEMON_SESSION_IDLE_SECONDS
env.description: Daemon mode idle session timeout (seconds).

env.name: DAEMON_SESSION_IDLE_CHECK_SECONDS
env.description: Daemon mode idle session check interval (seconds).

env.name: NODE_SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS_ENABLE
env.description: When true, include server instructions in MCP server info (node platform). Default: true.

env.name: NODE_POLICY_DEBUGGING_ENABLE
env.description: When true, include NODE_DEBUGGING_POLICY in server policies (node platform). Default: false.

env.name: NODE_INSPECTOR_HOST
env.description: Inspector host for debug_connect when MCP runs in Docker (e.g. host.docker.internal). Default: 127.0.0.1.

env.name: TOOL_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_DISABLE
env.description: When true, omit tool output schema from MCP tool registration (can reduce token usage for some clients).

env.name: AVAILABLE_TOOL_DOMAINS
env.description: Comma-separated tool domains to enable (e.g. navigation,interaction,a11y,scenario). Unset = all tools. Browser: a11y, content, debug, figma, interaction, navigation, o11y, react, scenario, run, stub, sync. Node: debug, run.

env.name: WORKING_DIR
env.description: Working directory for project-level config (.browser-devtools-mcp/). Default: process.cwd().

env.name: SEARCH_STRATEGY
env.description: Search strategy: SIMPLE (default, minisearch + stemmer) or FTS5 (better-sqlite3, optional dep).

env.name: SCENARIO_SEARCH_STRATEGY
env.description: Override SEARCH_STRATEGY for scenario search only.
